punchline: Art students who kept handling the 27 objects before drawing were still in art ten years later; the quick starters mostly were not.
thirty_sec: Art students were given 27 objects and asked to arrange a still life and draw it. Some started quickly; others handled more objects and took longer. Ten years on, about half had left art, and those who stayed were almost all the slower ones. Another decade later they were more successful by the art world's standards. Pink calls it problem finding.
